style: Industrial flat vector illustration in deep night teal (#102a2e), warm copper (#e08a52) and white, clean technical shapes, radiator-fin patterns, no text.

hero: A working radiator and tire shop interior: a car on a lift, a copper radiator on a workbench with a pressure tester, tall racks of tires, a pickup truck in the second bay.
